baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first question makes ahlamuhum the subject of ta'muruhum; the second recasts hum as qawmun taghun.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forbearance normally checks rash action, yet it is personified as issuing a directive. The double question tests whether the alleged output can come from self-restraint; the competing cause is a collective crossing its bound.

activation_trace.role: Command or directive identifies the explicit causal verb and makes the clause a test of who issues the demand.
Forbearance and self-restraint supply the faculty whose normal checking function is inverted into command.
A group of people supplies the corporate subject offered by the second question.
Overstepping in rebellion supplies the rival cause when restraint cannot plausibly command the act.

changed_reading.before: A generic taunt asks whether their minds tell them to speak this way.
changed_reading.after: The verse conducts a causal source test: can their own restraint really issue this directive, or is collective boundary-crossing the actual commander?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command verb, possessed plural ahlam, and singular collective qawm permit an inner council to become a corporate office.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ahlam can function as deliberative restraint, while amr can be consultation and an office of rule. Their group resolve has captured that council, so what looks like reason is an organ legitimating coercive collective will.

activation_trace.role: Consultation and deliberation let the command echo an inner council forming intent.
Authority and command-holding turn that council into a claimed seat of rule.
Disciplined restraint supplies the capacity that should govern deliberation rather than serve coercion.
Resolve and rising to undertake an affair make the group an acting will rather than a passive label.
Overbearing tyranny supplies the endpoint of deliberation captured by collective power.

changed_reading.before: Their reasoning faculty is simply defective.
changed_reading.after: Their deliberative faculty may be functioning but institutionally captured, issuing the verdicts desired by an overbearing group.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural ahlam can retain its dream-vision branch while remaining the grammatical commander of hadha.
baseline_models.mechanism: Private dream-images are promoted into signs and directives for the group. The question then mocks an oracle-like authorization system rather than only deficient rationality.

activation_trace.role: A sign or appointed marker lets command operate as supposed private authorization.
Dream-vision supplies the private imagery elevated into a source of instruction.
The people-group is the social body that receives and circulates the private directive.
False authority gives the dream-derived directive its unauthorized governing force.

changed_reading.after: A coexisting dream sense asks whether private visions have been made into omens that command the whole group.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The maturity branch of h-l-m can attach to ahlam while amr and qawm supply social authority and corporate standing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Attained adulthood is treated as self-certifying rank: because they count as mature members of the group, they presume authority to pronounce. The second question exposes maturity converted into license to exceed limits.

activation_trace.role: Attained puberty or adulthood supplies status mistaken for epistemic competence.
Office and authority convert adult status into a claimed right to issue judgments.
The group supplies the status-bearing social body.
Exceeding the proper bound marks the conversion of recognized standing into entitlement.

changed_reading.before: Their mature minds should know better.
changed_reading.after: The question may also ridicule status logic: does merely being adult confer authority for this, or has maturity become a license to overstep?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence command, restraint, corporate support, and overflow can be read as a compact control system inside the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: A group is a sustaining structure whose restraint should regulate growth. Instead, the structure amplifies its own directive until collective pressure surges beyond measure.

activation_trace.role: Growth and multiplication supply the amplifying input hidden inside the command root.
Self-restraint supplies the regulator that should absorb rising pressure.
Support and mainstay make qawm the structure by which the collective remains standing.
Overflowing force supplies the failure state when regulation no longer contains the collective.
The non-dominant mapped root independently preserves surging beyond material measure and reinforces the pressure model.

changed_reading.after: Their rebellion can coexist with a systems reading: a self-supporting collective has become an amplifying medium whose own restraint no longer contains it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context assembles a limit, a binding inscription, aligned rows, and an opened spread. Against that ordered field, the focus's inner command becomes a rival rule-source rather than a stray opinion.

activation_trace.role: The directive branch supplies the inner order whose jurisdiction is being tested.
Forbearance supplies the internal governor set against the external order.
Overstepping names what happens when the rival command crosses the given limit.
A boundary at which one stops or crosses supplies the spatial logic of transgression.
Binding inscription supplies an order not generated by their private faculties.
An aligned written row makes that order patterned and inspectable.
Opening and spreading make the inscribed order exposed rather than private.

structural_cues: The opening oath moves from a boundary-bearing landmark to a written, line-ordered, opened record before the focus's double question.
The focus's deictic hadha can therefore point within an already displayed field of signs and claims.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: boundary, binding inscription, aligned rows, and opening. Reader arrow: this ordered field makes the focus's internal command a competing jurisdiction. Live alternative: the oath sequence only certifies the warning and does not directly characterize their cognition.

changed_reading.before: The question is self-contained sarcasm about bad reasoning.
changed_reading.after: It asks whether private deliberation can legislate against an already bounded and publicly ordered field, making transgression a jurisdictional crossing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context materializes the focus's overflow branch: wide water is filled and ignited, the sky oscillates, and a normally solid raised mass is set in motion. Qawm becomes a containment structure whose failed restraint lets collective pressure destabilize what kept it standing.

activation_trace.role: Restraint supplies the missing regulator in the contextual pressure sequence.
Mainstay and subsistence make the people a support system capable of losing stability.
Overwhelming overflow gives the system's failed containment its focus-ayah endpoint.
Surging beyond physical measure independently anchors the material analogy in the split mapping.
Abundant wide water supplies the medium in which excess can accumulate.
Filling with water supplies saturation, the state immediately before containment fails.
Ignition and agitation add runaway energy to the saturated medium.
Oscillation and wave-motion carry the loss of stability from water into the sky.
A solid raised mass supplies the support expected to remain fixed but shown moving.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from raised enclosure and saturated sea to oscillating sky and traveling mountains.
Material supports fail in the same order that the focus moves from restraint and collective support to overflow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a wide medium, saturation or ignition, oscillation, and displaced solidity. Reader arrow: these states model a social control failure in qawm taghun. Live alternative: the images describe only cosmic unmaking and do not map causally onto the group.

changed_reading.before: Taghun denotes only deliberate moral rebellion.
changed_reading.after: It also renders the group as a pressurized medium: collective amplification outruns restraint until even its standing supports become unstable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The blessed collective is formed by loyal following and joining, yet every individual remains held by a claim and the group turns face-to-face in mutual questioning. This supplies a counter-polity: healthy belonging preserves personal liability and reciprocal inquiry, whereas the focus group lets corporate authority capture deliberation.

activation_trace.role: Deliberation supplies the social function that can remain reciprocal or become captured.
The people-group is re-read as an organized relation among members rather than a bare category.
Transgressive false authority names the group form that substitutes itself for accountable counsel.
Loyal following supplies cohesion without by itself erasing distinct members.
A later member reaching and joining those ahead supplies incorporation into the collective.
The individual person prevents the corporate scene from absorbing personal agency.
A pledge held against a right supplies continuing individual liability inside belonging.
A group facing one another supplies reciprocal rather than top-down social orientation.
Mutual questioning supplies a dialogic alternative to a captured inner council.

structural_cues: Family following and joining are immediately qualified by the singular every person and individual pledge.
The resulting collective faces inward in mutual questioning rather than speaking through one coercive office.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: incorporation, individual pledge, face-to-face orientation, and reciprocal questioning. Reader arrow: this is a social counter-model that diagnoses the focus qawm as captured deliberation. Live alternative: the blessed scene concerns reward and family continuity without commenting on the focus group's decision process.

changed_reading.before: Qawm merely identifies the kind of people they are.
changed_reading.after: Qawm diagnoses how they are organized: peer belonging has hardened into a corporate authority that commands members instead of preserving accountable mutual inquiry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sits inside a rapid sequence of labels: hidden-news diviner, reason-veiled madman, poet, fabricator, then a challenge to produce comparable discourse truthfully. Ahlam becomes the classifier generating incompatible outputs, and ta'muru asks what rule makes those outputs obligatory.

activation_trace.role: Deliberation makes the question an inquiry into the process that selects and authorizes each label.
Measured restraint supplies the stable discrimination that the rotating accusations lack.
Overstepping supplies a causal explanation for speech that outruns its own evidentiary limits.
A diviner claiming hidden reports supplies the first epistemic classification.
Reason veiled by madness supplies an incompatible second explanation of the same speaker.
Fine knowledge and discernment expose the cognitive claim implicit in naming someone a poet.
Poetic composition supplies the explicit third classification in the accusation sequence.
Attributing speech that did not occur supplies the later fabrication charge.
Renewed report or discourse supplies the object they are challenged to reproduce.
Truthful speech supplies the criterion absent from the rotating labels.

structural_cues: The focus is bracketed by accusations in 52:29-30 and the fabrication claim and discourse challenge in 52:33-34.
The labels alternate between excess access, impaired reason, crafted speech, and invented speech without stabilizing on one account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a sequence of incompatible classifications followed by a production challenge. Reader arrow: hadha denotes this accusation-generating practice, so the focus asks what cognitive rule outputs it. Live alternative: each label is an independent insult and the focus only rebukes them generally.

changed_reading.before: The verse says their intelligence should reject one false claim.
changed_reading.after: It audits a classifier: what supposedly measured faculty keeps issuing mutually unstable labels, and why does the group treat each output as binding?

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated am questions after the focus remove every possible warrant for command: creation, controlling oversight, ascent and privileged hearing, compelling proof, access to the hidden, and inscription. The focus is therefore the first jurisdictional hearing in a longer audit, not merely a comment on intelligence.

activation_trace.role: Authority and command-holding identify the jurisdiction claimed by their inner faculty.
Guardianship and governance make the collective's claim one of custodial standing.
False authority names the result when command persists after its warrants are removed.
Creative origination supplies the maximal authority the sequence denies them.
Controlling surveillance supplies the office they are asked whether they occupy.
A ladder or means of ascent supplies the proposed access route to higher information.
Understanding and compliance make privileged hearing consequential rather than merely acoustic.
Compelling proof supplies the warrant their listener would have to bring.
What is hidden from sight supplies the inaccessible knowledge they claim to record.
Writing and a written record supply the final asserted means of fixing hidden knowledge.

structural_cues: The repeated am chain from 52:35 through 52:43 formally extends the focus's two am questions.
Each question removes a different basis for issuing, hearing, proving, or recording an authoritative claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated alternatives deny creatorhood, oversight, ascent, hearing, proof, hidden access, and writing. Reader arrow: the focus's personified ahlam occupy the first alleged command office in this jurisdictional audit. Live alternative: the later questions are independent proofs with no special backward effect on ahlam.

changed_reading.before: Their minds happen to produce a bad idea.
changed_reading.after: Their minds have been installed as an unauthorized command office, and the following questions systematically revoke every possible warrant for that office.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later scene supplies an observable cognition pipeline: they see a detached piece falling, then verbally recategorize it as an accumulated cloud. The dream branch of ahlam can now act as wish-image, while ta'muru is the arrow by which preferred imagery commands perception and group speech.

activation_trace.role: Directive force supplies the arrow from inner image to public classification.
Dream-vision supplies the preferred inner image that can govern waking interpretation.
Overstepping marks interpretation moving beyond what the seen object warrants.
Eyesight and insight supply the perceptual input that should constrain the judgment.
Dream-vision cross-activates the focus's dream sense at the very point of seeing.
A piece detached from a body supplies the threatening object actually presented.
Downward falling fixes the object's dangerous trajectory.
Speech operating as conjecture supplies the recategorizing output.
A trailing cloud supplies the benign category imposed on the falling piece.
Layering one thing upon another completes the alternate cloud description.

structural_cues: The clause presents a direct transformation: see X falling, then say Y accumulated.
Perception and speech are adjacent, making the direction of recategorization visible even though its motive remains unstated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a seen falling piece and a spoken piled-cloud label, plus sight and dream branches. Reader arrow: a preferred dream-image commands the recategorization. Live alternatives: deliberate verbal defiance, habitual denial, or a nonpsychological description of persistence.

changed_reading.before: The dream sense of ahlam is an isolated lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The later scene demonstrates how a dreamlike preference can command waking classification: threatening evidence is seen, then renamed into the image the group wants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close supplies a counter-model of command: patient restraint under judgment and watchful care, followed by praise when rising. Qawm shifts from a collective noun in the focus to embodied undertaking in taqum, contrasting autonomous group command with disciplined standing under a higher rule.

activation_trace.role: Command authority supplies the disputed office contrasted with the closing imperatives.
Forbearance supplies the inward discipline embodied by the closing patience.
The people-group supplies the corporate identity contrasted with one person's enacted standing.
Overstepping supplies the autonomous posture reversed by standing under judgment.
Holding the self against panic supplies the enacted form of h-l-m restraint.
Preventive restraint for correction supplies the higher rule under which patience operates.
Accurate wisdom supplies an external measure superior to self-authorizing ahlam.
Watchful care makes submission to judgment protective rather than merely coercive.
Rising with resolve turns q-w-m from group identity into disciplined undertaking.
Declaring transcendence clears the higher authority of the group's projections.
Praise supplies the speech produced by disciplined standing rather than accusation.

structural_cues: The closing imperatives answer the focus's question about command with a visible sequence of patience, judgment, care, praise, and rising.
The same q-w-m root moves from collective identity at the focus to a bodily undertaking at 52:48.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: commands to endure, judgment, watchful care, praise, and rising. Reader arrow: this closing sequence is a positive counter-model to self-commanding ahlam and qawm taghun. Live alternative: it consoles the messenger without deliberately answering the focus's command problem.

changed_reading.before: The focus only exposes the opponents' irrationality.
changed_reading.after: It contrasts two command economies: a collective that installs its own faculties as ruler, and disciplined standing that receives judgment, remains restrained, and produces praise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the detached-portion branch belongs to the non-dominant t-gh-w mapping and is form-distant from the participle taghun. It remains packet-anchored through the exact focus root and the later detached sky-piece plus dream-vision sequence. Downstream prose should call it a lexical afterimage or resonance, never a translation of taghun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split focus root t-gh-y/t-gh-w includes a small detached portion branch, while ahlam preserves dream-vision; 52:44 later presents a detached falling piece under altered seeing.

activation_trace.role: A small detached portion supplies the odd material afterimage carried by the split focus root.
Dream-vision makes the detached-piece resonance part of an altered-perception model.
A piece separated from a body gives the later context an exact detached object.
Dream-vision at the seeing root links that object back to the focus's ahlam branch.

changed_reading.before: The t-gh-y root contributes only abstract moral excess.
changed_reading.after: Without replacing moral excess, it carries a faint detached-piece resonance that binds dream-command in the focus to the later falling fragment misperceived as cloud.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus's noise branch is a dialectal noun under the non-dominant mapping, while the voice branches of gh-n-y and k-y-d are also distant from their local forms. It remains anchored by qawm taghun and the immediate severe-sound, ineffective-plot, and failed-support sequence. Render only as an acoustic reversal, not as a lexical gloss that the people are merely noisy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places qawm directly beside a split-root branch glossed as the people's voice or noise; 52:45-46 then opposes severe sound to their ineffective effort and absent support.

activation_trace.role: The people-group supplies the collective body whose public sound can constitute identity.
Their voice or noise supplies the rare acoustic branch attached directly to the focus group.
A severe overwhelming sound supplies the force that reverses collective clamor.
Effortful shouting gives their ineffective scheme a branch-distant acoustic edge.
Voice or singing echoes inside the statement that their effort will not avail them.
Aid and vindication supply the support explicitly absent after the acoustic reversal.

changed_reading.before: The second question classifies a morally transgressive people.
changed_reading.after: It can also carry a contained acoustic resonance: a people constituted by self-amplifying clamor are finally met by a sound that nullifies their scheme and leaves no supporting response.

strongest_changes: The focus became a source-and-jurisdiction audit rather than a generic insult to intelligence; the later am chain removes every warrant for the command office their ahlam occupy.
The sea, oscillating sky, and moving mountain strengthened a material systems reading in which collective pressure outruns restraint and destabilizes its supports.
The rotating accusations and the seen-piece-to-cloud recategorization turned ahlam into a claim generator whose preferred imagery can command public classification.
The closing patience, judgment, care, and rising supplied a positive counter-model of disciplined standing under authority.
summary.what_was_special: Several readings remain live together: restraint inverted into command, an inner council captured by corporate power, dream-oracle authorization, adulthood used as license, hydraulic overflow, peer-polity failure, and contained detached-piece and acoustic resonances from the split t-gh-y mapping.
remaining_uncertainties: The dream and adulthood branches of ahlam may be deliberate secondary activations or only lexical pressure around the dominant reason-and-forbearance sense.
The detached-piece and noise links are packet-grounded but form-distant; they should remain exploratory resonances rather than substitutions for ordinary transgression.
The causal direction remains open: corporate overstepping may capture deliberation, or already captured deliberation may constitute the overstepping group.
